senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כּוֹס I)receptacle, pouch, bag; purse, fund.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 39b:13">Bekh. 39ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 4:6">Tosef. ib. IV, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00117"><he>זוּבָּן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:1">B. Kam. X, 1</cite> <he>כ׳ של גבאין</he> the collection fund of (royal) collectors.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 10:4">Keth. X, 4</cite> <he>שהטילו לכ׳</he> who formed a partnership for business.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:5:11">Y. Hor. III, 48ᶜ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 16:11">Prov. XVI, 11</cite>) <he>כולהם … מכ׳ אחד</he> all of them receive their wages out of the same fund (of divine rewards).—<he>חסרון כ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H01415"><he>חֶסְרוֹן</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 53a:12">Sabb. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>הזב בכ׳ שלו</he> the gonorrhoist with his bag (for his genitals); <he>העזים בכ׳ וכ׳</he> the goats with the bag over their teats; Tosef. ib. IV (V), 5 <he>בכיסין</he>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12:1">Lev. R. s. 12</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="K00576"><he>כיס</he></cite>, K’ri <cite ref="K00316"><he>כוס</he></cite>, <cite ref="Proverbs 23:31">Prov. XXIII, 31</cite>) <he>הוא נותן עינו בכוס וחנוני … בכ׳</he> he (the drunkard) sets his eye on the cup, the shopkeeper—on the money bag.

<cite ref="Proverbs 23:31">Ib.</cite> <he>בכיס כתיב לשון נקי הוא</he> it is written (Prov. l. c.) ‘on the bag’ which is a euphemism (for illicit intercourse) as in (<cite ref="Proverbs 1:14">Prov. I, 14</cite>) &c. Tanḥ. Sh’mini 11; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כִּיסִים</he>, <he>כִּיסִין</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:3:3">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᵈ</cite> bot.—Tosef. l. c.; a. e.
